They don't actually care about the economy. They only care about stuff like transgender people being attacked.¶ Donald Trump is a widely unpopular president. Does that matter?¶ There is an understanding amongst Democrats, however true, that Republicans are losing their enthusiasm for Trump. who might detest Trump but still consider themselves aligned with their chosen party. While they're getting better at focusing on affordability,
